domain_veto_over_veto_measurement.shape_of_the_loss: Almost all are read-only status and list families, and the paraphrases that lose them are ordinary: 'sacame la relacion de copias locales recuperables' for backup.list, 'dejame una instantanea de como se ve el escritorio' for capture.screenshot, 'que palabras tengo listas para pegar' for clipboard.read.text. domain_veto_over_veto_measurement.proposed_design: Two mechanisms rather than one. (1) A conflicting-domain veto, one-sided and per clause, that removes authority only when the text names another family's exclusive domain. (2) Direction discrimination kept separate and narrower, keyed on the verb rather than the domain, for families with opposite directions. Simply inverting the rule would return the 3672 but lose the near-miss collisions the curated rules catch: 'haz un appointment con el doctor' names the calendar domain with no conflict, and without direction discrimination could execute a listing when a creation was asked.
domain_veto_over_veto_measurement.status: recorded and NOT implemented. It changes the path that authorises effects, so claiming it requires a fresh cut-D seal, which is where the defect is active. Implementing it without that measurement would repeat exactly the error R103 already made by calibrating against seen surfaces.
domain_veto_over_veto_measurement.correction: The 37.3% figure is the gate's disposition, not realized harm, and publishing it alone overstated the defect. The gate is consulted only when the deterministic path fails. Over the same seven populations: 3822 of 4004 action rows resolve deterministically and never reach it; 2324 of those carry a target the gate would have refused had it been asked, which is latent disposition; only 182 rows actually reach the gate, and 84 of those would be refused. Realized cost on populations of this kind is therefore 84 of 4004, 2.1%. Six of the 84 are an artefact of a Python-only probe: the memory.status rows are resolved by the C# parser.
domain_veto_over_veto_measurement.blocking_problem: There is no instrument that can see this defect. Generated cut-B populations now almost never fail deterministic resolution, so they almost never reach the veto. Changing the path that authorises effects without a population able to measure the change is precisely what must not be done.
domain_veto_over_veto_measurement.next_step: Build the population that measures it: in-catalogue requests phrased so the deterministic path misses and the proposal reaches the veto. Only then implement the two mechanisms.

domain_gate_is_inverted_on_paraphrase.measurement: The domain gate was asked about both operations of every V2 case: the one the person wanted and the one the system executed.
domain_gate_is_inverted_on_paraphrase.result: In all seven cases that failed, the gate refused the correct operation and permitted the wrong one. In the single case that succeeded it grounded the correct one. The correlation is exact on the sample, 8 of 8.
domain_gate_is_inverted_on_paraphrase.mechanism: 'que trastos tengo colgando del equipo' does not contain the word for peripherals, so peripheral.list is vetoed for absence; it does contain 'equipo', which is exactly what system.status asks for, so that one is grounded. The paraphrase drops the specific term and keeps the generic one, and a gate that judges each operation in isolation systematically rewards the more generic candidate.
domain_gate_is_inverted_on_paraphrase.reframes: R110 called it 'fires on absence', R111 'a coverage gap', R115 'near-miss is the dominant behaviour'. All three were symptoms of one structural defect: the gate issues absolute, independent, per-operation verdicts, and the problem is comparative. No rule of the form 'is X grounded?' can express 'peripheral.list fits here better than system.status', which is the decision that actually has to be made.
domain_gate_is_inverted_on_paraphrase.why_neither_direction_helps: Relaxing the veto lets more wrong operations through; adding coverage worsens the bias toward the generic, because generic operations are the easiest to ground.
domain_gate_is_inverted_on_paraphrase.reform_required: Architectural, not a threshold: candidates must be compared against each other against the domain the request names, and the veto must act on the result of that comparison. A one-sided per-operation gate will keep rewarding the generic by construction, under any calibration.
domain_gate_is_inverted_on_paraphrase.status: recorded, not implemented. V1 and V2 are consumed; the reform touches the path that authorises effects and must be measured against a fresh V3 with the same discipline: inclusion criterion declared first, and what it confirms and what it expects to reappear written into the preregistration.

weighted_comparative_veto.idea: Weigh each term by how few operations the alias corpus attaches it to, and veto a proposal carrying no distinctive evidence when another operation carries some. One-sided, and inert on ties including ties at zero.
weighted_comparative_veto.why_it_looked_right: On its own cases it reversed the inversion exactly -- peripheral.list 1.48 against system.status 0.00, system.process.list 1.48 against window.application.status 0.00, notification.list.due 5.85 against reminder.list 4.37 -- and stopped four of V2's seven wrong executions.
weighted_comparative_veto.why_it_was_rejected: It refused three of six plainly ordinary requests: 'revisa el estado del audio' for audio.status, 'pega esto en el bloc de notas' for clipboard.paste, and 'crea una nota local titulada Faro con contenido luz' for note.create -- which is literally the text of a physical dependent mission that currently passes 3/3. Adopting it would have broken a green campaign to fix a red one.
weighted_comparative_veto.lesson: The rule was derived from the cases that failed and checked on those same cases. That is the error R103 made calibrating against seen surfaces and R110 repeated publishing disposition as harm. An instrument derived from a handful of failures will always look free on that handful.
weighted_comparative_veto.pattern_across_three_attempts: Three catalogue-derived gates have now been tried and rejected: R103's for over-veto on cut B, and this one for breaking ordinary requests. The pattern suggests the alias corpus does not contain the needed signal at all -- 'equipo', 'sistema', 'periferico', 'respaldo' and 'pegar' all weigh zero because the corpus never uses them literally. A gate built on it cannot know that 'trastos colgando' means peripherals, because the corpus does not know either.
weighted_comparative_veto.what_survives: R116 is not retracted: comparative ranking is still the right shape. It needs a source of signal the alias corpus does not provide, which is vocabulary work rather than threshold work.
weighted_comparative_veto.code_state: Not kept as dead code. Only this record and a comment at the point where it would have lived.

veto_reach_v3.comparability_caveat: V3 leaves 23 of 29 reaching nothing (79%) against V2's 62%. That is neither a regression nor an improvement: it is not comparable. The surfaces are authored, and they were made deliberately more oblique from one population to the next -- 'quien anda faenando ahi abajo sin verse' is harder than 'que cosas estan corriendo por dentro'. A regression rate across populations whose difficulty the author chooses measures the author, not the product. What is comparable inside one seal is the binary: a guard fires or it does not.

counterfactual_behind_a_denial_frame_loc.mechanism: The counterfactual detector in __main__.py is anchored to '^'. R27's denial frames stay in front of the body because _strip_request_envelope does not remove them and explicit_non_action_frame does not recognise them -- its _EXPLICIT_NON_ACTION_FRAME class is still a hand-listed alternation of whole sentences, while the positive instruction frame is generated from the cognate groups. The anchor never reaches the body.
counterfactual_behind_a_denial_frame_loc.the_repair_already_exists: _strip_explicit_no_action_frame has been in effect_intent.py since R25, with the argument that removing a denial can only move a turn toward conversation and never toward an effect, and it is generated from the same cognate groups as the positive frame. It cleans all 21 cases.
counterfactual_behind_a_denial_frame_loc.why_it_was_not_applied_in_bulk: _explicit_conversation_turn_decision evaluates ~28 anchored patterns, one of which is leading_negation. Six of the seven denial frames start with a negation word and therefore close the turn as conversation through THAT pattern today. Stripping the frame before all of them removes that net, so a body that merely quotes an order -- 'no es una orden para el pc, dime nomas: abre chrome' -- would fall through to the model. That trades a presentation defect for an unsolicited-effect risk while the hard zero is open. The application must be scoped to the hypothetical and counterfactual detectors only.

repair.scope: _strip_explicit_no_action_frame is applied only to the two hypothesis detectors in _explicit_stable_no_effect_turn_decision. Every other anchored pattern keeps reading the unstripped text, because leading_negation is what closes a denial-framed body that merely quotes an order.

but_it_still_found_something_real.repair_of_the_repair: The reading is an offence only when predicated of THIS machine NOW: a definite present statement of the value, a binding to the person's own device, or an explicit deictic. readingless_fabrications_partly_repaired.insight: The eleven legitimate replies that made a claim-only widening unadoptable were not claims about the machine at all: they were questions and explicit inabilities, which Spanish builds with 'estas ...ndo'. The separator is not the claim's shape, it is whether the turn asserts at all. In a conversation turn the first signal cannot exist before it finishes, because it is the call that decides the turn is a conversation. No reform of the writing side can reach the bar while that call costs what it costs. The three Spanish requests carry 28, 28 and 11; the three English ones 2, 9 and 2. A photosynthesis question has nothing to do with the catalogue.
